band_change_evidence_test.required: at least 2 independent sources with at least 1 at sourceTier >= 4
band_change_evidence_test.reason: FAIL. Two independent sources were located — GeekWire and TechCrunch — both at tier 2 to 3. The company's own update page returned HTTP 403 and could not be read. No source at tier 4 or above was obtained. Adept AI cannot be verified at tier 4 in either direction.

key_evidence: Adept AI is an entity-record currency problem, not a scoring problem. Amazon hired its leadership and licensed its technology in July 2024, and reporting puts the remaining company at roughly 20 employees, down from about 100.

It is still operating under its own name, led by former engineering director Zach Brock, so it is not the Rethink Robotics case of a dissolved company still ranked. But it is not the company the index entry describes.
Thirty-nine of 40 subdimensions rest on complete absence of evidence. No adverse conduct of any kind was found — no lawsuits, no labour findings, no regulatory action, nothing.
The 22.8-point fall measures missing disclosure by a 20-person company, and nothing else. It should not be read as a finding about conduct.
The open question is whether a 20-person residual entity belongs in a published ranking at all. That is a scope question for the index, not a scoring question.

evidence.claim: Four of the five Adept co-founders who joined Amazon as part of the 2024 arrangement have left, the most recent being chief executive David Luan in February 2026.
evidence.source: GeekWire on departures from the Amazon and Adept arrangement

evidence.claim: Amazon hired Luan and other Adept leaders and licensed the startup's agent technology and AI models, while Adept continued operating independently with its remaining employees.
evidence.source: Reporting on the Amazon licensing arrangement with Adept

evidence.claim: The technology licensing agreement with Amazon was followed by Amazon hiring a significant portion of the original 100-person workforce, leaving the firm operating with approximately 20 remaining employees. Engineering director Zach Brock took over as chief executive.
evidence.source: Company profile of Adept AI after the Amazon arrangement

notes: FLAG FOR REVIEW — NOT A DOWNGRADE. No score change is proposed for application. The published 48.4 is a never-assessed uniform-seed placeholder shared byte-for-byte with seven other ai-labs entities at consecutive alphabetical ranks; the rank is an artefact of the tie. No adverse conduct was located. The entire gap measures disclosure, not conduct. Applying a one-off baseline reset on evidence-absence alone would convert a calibration problem into a conduct finding, which the anti-false-positive screen forbids.
